title: Исход 36 — Exodus 36
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Они получили от ___ все приношения, которые собрали израилетяне.
cases.translation: They received from Moses all the offerings that the Israelites had collected.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) takes the genitive → Моисея.

cases.sentence: Они сделали её из десяти ___ крученого льна.
cases.translation: They made it from ten curtains of twined linen.
cases.explain: After the numeral десять (ten) the noun takes the genitive plural → покрывал.

cases.sentence: Он сделал ___ из голубой ткани по краю последнего покрывала.
cases.translation: He made loops of blue fabric along the edge of the last curtain.
cases.explain: Петли is the direct object of сделал (made); for an inanimate plural the accusative equals the nominative → петли.

cases.sentence: Эти угловые брусья были скреплены вверху одним ___.
cases.translation: These corner boards were fastened together at the top by a single ring.
cases.explain: The means by which they were fastened (скреплены) is expressed by the instrumental → кольцом.

cases.sentence: Он сделал петли по ___ последнего покрывала.
cases.translation: He made loops along the edge of the last curtain.
cases.explain: The preposition по (along) takes the dative → краю.

cases.sentence: Он сделал по 50 петель по краю последних покрывал в обоих ___.
cases.translation: He made fifty loops along the edge of the outermost curtains in both sets.
cases.explain: The preposition в meaning "in" a location takes the prepositional → рядах (prepositional plural).

cases.sentence: Каждый ___ был 10 локтей в длину и 1,5 в ширину.
cases.translation: Each board was ten cubits long and one and a half wide.
cases.explain: Брус is the subject of был (was), so it takes the nominative → брус.

cases.sentence: Он сделал ___ из голубой, пурпурной и алой пряжи.
cases.translation: He made a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
cases.explain: Завесу is the direct object of сделал (made); a feminine -а noun takes -у in the accusative → завесу.

reading.ru: Народ приносит больше, чем нужно для работы, которую повелел сделать Господь.
reading.question: What did the craftsmen report to Moses?
options: The people were bringing more than was needed
reading.correct: The people were bringing more than was needed
reading.explain: The craftsmen said the people were bringing more than was needed for the work the Lord had commanded.

reading.ru: Моисей приказал, и по всему лагерю объявили, пусть ни мужчина, ни женщина не делают больше приношений для святилища.
reading.question: What did Moses proclaim throughout the camp?
options: That no one should bring any more offerings
reading.correct: That no one should bring any more offerings
reading.explain: Moses commanded that neither man nor woman should make any more offerings for the sanctuary.

reading.ru: Он сделал 11 покрывал из козьей шерсти, покров скинии.
reading.question: What was made from goats' hair?
options: Eleven curtains as a covering for the tabernacle
reading.correct: Eleven curtains as a covering for the tabernacle
reading.explain: He made eleven curtains of goats' hair as a covering over the tabernacle.

reading.ru: Он сделал для скинии прямые брусья из акации.
reading.question: From what wood were the upright boards of the tabernacle made?
reading.explain: He made the straight boards for the tabernacle out of acacia wood.

reading.ru: Он сделал 50 золотых крючков и сцепил ими оба ряда покрывал, чтобы скиния стала одним целым.
reading.question: What did the fifty gold clasps accomplish?
options: They joined the two sets of curtains into one whole
reading.correct: They joined the two sets of curtains into one whole
reading.explain: He made fifty gold clasps and coupled the two sets of curtains with them so the tabernacle became a single unit.

reading.ru: Он сделал завесу из голубой, пурпурной и алой пряжи, крученого льна с искусно вышитыми на ней херувимами.
reading.question: What was skillfully worked into the veil?
reading.explain: The veil was made of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and twined linen, with cherubim skillfully embroidered on it.
